description: Final cleanup and modernization pass after TanStack migration. Remove any remaining Convex reactive imports, clean up the project structure, update documentation, and ensure a clean modern codebase.
steps: Remove the ConvexProvider/ConvexReactClient from _app.tsx if still present (should only have QueryClientProvider now).

Clean up the convex/ directory: Keep schema.ts (for reference/types), stations.ts, cameras.ts, waterLevelHistory.ts, waterLevelSummaries.ts, crons.ts, and the _generated/ directory (needed for types). Remove http.ts, sync/ directory if they only contain auth-related code.
Update lib/FilterContext.tsx to remove any commented references to favorites or auth.

Update components/AdvancedFilter.tsx and components/FavoritesFilter.tsx - if FavoritesFilter is now pointless without auth, remove it and its usage from pages/stations/index.tsx and pages/cameras/index.tsx. If AdvancedFilter still has favorites-related props (isLoggedIn, favoriteStations), remove those props.
Remove the plan.md file from the root - it is an old mobile-first refactoring plan that is no longer actionable.
Remove the data/ directory if it only contains old migration data.
Update README.md to reflect the current tech stack: Next.js 14 + TanStack Query + Convex + Tailwind CSS + Radix UI/shadcn.
Update package.json scripts: remove convex:dev and convex:deploy scripts if not needed for this frontend-only deployment. Remove migrate:data script.
Ensure all TypeScript types are clean - no 'any' types introduced during migration.
Run final npm run build and npm run lint to confirm clean state.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
No imports from 'convex/react' remain in page or component files
README.md accurately describes the current project
No stale migration/plan documents remain in the root
FavoritesFilter component is removed (auth removed = favorites removed)
Project has a clear, minimal structure with no dead code
findings: convex/sync/ directory kept - it contains active backend data sync logic (stationUpdater, cameraUpdater, waterLevelUpdater) not auth-related. convex/http.ts removed (empty router). The FavoriteIcon export remains in IconLibrary.tsx as it may be used in future features but is no longer imported by any active component. Build generates public/sw.js changes which were included in the commit.
